prompt:
Use case: style-transfer and character redesign. EDIT the attached Docker fighter atlas into a much grittier CYBERPUNK arcade fighter. Preserve the general identity: older broad-built human dockworker, blue beanie, blue workwear, whale forearm tattoo, and same nine-frame atlas function. REVISED CHARACTER: mature human adult, grounded fighting-game anatomy about 7 heads tall, heavy muscular build but less rounded inflated toy-muscle proportions. Smaller head relative to body, small realistic eyes, weathered angular face, broken nose, coarse salt-and-pepper stubble instead of fluffy white beard, stern tired expression and subtle sneer, NOT broad smile. One temple has a visible gunmetal cybernetic implant with a narrow electric-cyan light; metal connector at back of neck. Battered dark-cobalt beanie, low profile.
Outfit: asymmetrical cropped cobalt-blue industrial motorcycle/dock jacket, sleeves cut above elbows, jagged worn hems, black reinforced panels, oily seams and tiny cyan circuit strips. NO huge mechanical glove; forearms and fists mostly human. Charcoal cargo trousers with patched cobalt knee fabric, dirty black boots, compact utility belt and attached short cable loops. Blue accents over charcoal base, cyan sparse and sharp. Cloth visibly worn before fight, industrial grime, metal scratched; no random decals or lettering. This should read as a dangerous veteran of a neon port district, not a friendly sailor mascot. No flames, orange armor, weapon, helmet, cape or fantasy styling.

STYLE: detailed gritty 16-bit CYBERPUNK FIGHTING GAME pixel art with mature human proportions, realistic small facial features, crisp stepped pixel contours and clustered pixel shading. Original late-1990s arcade street-fighter visual language. NO chibi, no comic-book mascot, no big expressive cartoon eyes, no smooth vector or painterly rendering, no glossy clean blue suit, no round toy shoulder pads. Build all nine frames consistently from this redesigned model.

LAYOUT: exactly 9 equal square cells, strict 3 columns x 3 rows on square true-alpha transparent PNG. No drawn background, no grid or labels, no text, no scenery, no shadow. At least 7% transparent padding INSIDE every cell on all edges. Every figure entirely inside its cell, no touching or clipping. Full-body sprites face RIGHT three-quarter view; feet share baseline and consistent scale. Standing sprite max 80% cell height including hat and arms.
TOP TWO ROWS: six CLEAN pre-fight idle frames of same redesign. Grounded heavy staggered stance, fists low at abdomen, slowly tightening wrist wrap with opposite hand, small neck and shoulder shift. Only subtle changes; feet planted. Worn clothes and old scars are normal character design; no new injury or bandage before fight.
BOTTOM LEFT: battered defeated seated pose, one knee raised, elbow on knee and hand nursing sore jaw, head tipped down, beanie slipped over eyebrow, added cheek bandage and torn jacket seams. No blood.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: battered victory standing exhausted, subtly flexes whale-tattooed forearm at shoulder level while other hand rests on sore lower back, a restrained crooked smirk rather than big grin, same bandage and scuffs. Keep entire arm inside cell padding.
BOTTOM RIGHT: CLEAN enlarged head-and-shoulders portrait of redesigned weathered adult with rough stubble, blue beanie, narrow cyan temple implant, scarred nose, dark-blue worn jacket and ribbed industrial shoulder plate. No fresh injury or bandage in portrait. Face anatomically adult and serious.
Keep cyberpunk modifications identical in all nine. Preserve true transparency.
